== Biography ==
'''Nathaniel Glasgow''' was named in a pre-1858 probate-index entry for '''Drumgreenagh, County Armagh''', in '''1809'''.<ref>Public Record Office of Northern Ireland, ''Names, Pre-1858 Wills and Admons'', “Nathaniel Glasgow, Drumgreenagh, 1809,” [https://apps.proni.gov.uk/ProniNames_IE/SearchPage.aspx public search page], catalogue source reference 0ff2e8e7ec743ee8, accessed 19 August 2026. Item-detail URLs are session-bound.</ref>

His birth is shown only as before 1768, an uncertain boundary estimate consistent with his witnessing a deed made in February 1786. The index does not establish his birth place, exact death date or place, marital status, or any relatives. Drumgreenagh is therefore recorded only as his documented probate residence.

A deed of assignment dated 13 February 1786 and registered on 22 December 1792 names '''Nathaniel Glasgow of Drumgreenagh, farmer''', as a witness to a transaction between David Murphy of Lislea and John Glasgow of Drumgreenagh.<ref>Registry of Deeds, Ireland, memorial of deed of assignment, David Murphy to John Glasgow, deed dated 13 February 1786, registered 22 December 1792; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSJW-VDTD FamilySearch image].</ref> This establishes Nathaniel's residence, occupation and activity by 1786, but the memorial states no relationship between Nathaniel and John.

A 1813 Drogheda probate-index entry also names Nathaniel Glasgow, but supplies no residence.<ref>Public Record Office of Northern Ireland, ''Names, Pre-1858 Wills and Admons'', “Nathaniel Glasgow, Drogheda probate; residence absent, 1813,” [https://apps.proni.gov.uk/ProniNames_IE/SearchPage.aspx public search page], catalogue source reference 87766638eb8c69df, accessed 19 August 2026. Item-detail URLs are session-bound.</ref> The rarity of the name makes a later action concerning the Drumgreenagh man possible, but the surviving index information does not prove that the entries concern the same man. Drogheda is the probate venue, not a proved residence.

== Research Notes ==
No relationship to the other Glasgow people indexed at Drumgreenagh or nearby Mowillin has been proved.

Possibly the same person as [[Glasgow-1452|Nathaniel Glasgow (bef.1774-)]]
